name: Real Estate Investment Residence Permit (Law No. 16 of 2018 / CoM Decision No. 28 of 2020)

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum QAR 730,000 (~USD 200,000) property investment in a designated freehold or usufruct area, tied to continued ownership.
requirements.fix_path: Purchase qualifying real estate at or above the threshold.

outcome_override.duration_length: renewable residence permit, tied to continued ownership

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum QAR 3,650,000 (~USD 1,000,000) property investment, unlocking enhanced ('First Class') benefits including rights to invest in select economic activities.
requirements.fix_path: Purchase qualifying real estate at or above the enhanced threshold.

evidence_required.document: Title deed / property purchase contract in a qualifying area

outcome.duration_length: indefinite, renewable, tied to continued property ownership

sources.title: Aqarat -- Real Estate Regulatory Authority, Ministry of Justice, State of Qatar: foreign property ownership regime, 9 designated freehold areas (unrestricted, no time limit) and 16 usufruct areas (99-year renewable rights), residence-permit eligibility tied to investment value

Qatar Tourism -- official instruction manual citing Council of Ministers Decision No. 28 of 2020: QAR 730,000 threshold for standard residence permit, QAR 3,650,000 threshold for enhanced ('First Class') benefits
Sharek.gov.qa (Ministry of Justice e-service) -- real estate residence approval: process and required documents

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Qatar). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- fully tier-1 sourced across three government bodies (Real Estate Regulatory Authority/Ministry of Justice, Qatar Tourism, and the Ministry of Justice's own e-service portal). This is Qatar's functional equivalent to a Gulf-neighbor 'golden visa,' but Qatar does NOT officially brand it that way -- 'Golden Visa' terminology found only on tier-3/4 immigration-marketing sites and is NOT used here as an official route name. DISCLOSED, NOT MODELED AS A SEPARATE FILE: a distinct company-ownership residency route also exists (100% foreign ownership via Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Qatar Financial Centre, or Qatar Free Zones Authority, with the company sponsoring the owner's residence permit) -- specific eligibility thresholds for that route were not confirmed at tier-1/2 in this pass, so it is disclosed here rather than built as its own file. The 'enhanced_threshold' group's exact list of which 'select economic activities' become investable was not itemized by the sources -- outcome fields for this file reflect the baseline (standard_threshold) tier; the enhanced tier's incremental benefits are qualitative only in the current sourcing.
